repositoryDescription: Early-stage, local-first Windows piano sight-reading practice for user-provided MusicXML/MXL scores, with optional MIDI-controller input.

responses.question: Why does this repository qualify?
responses.answer: Cadenza is an early-stage, incomplete GPL-3.0-only Windows piano-practice project for user-owned MusicXML/MXL scores. It matters as a small, inspectable testbed for notation parsing, repeat-aware timelines, WebView2 engraving, and optional MIDI input. It has no significant adoption or proven educational outcomes. The maintainer reviews all AI-assisted changes.

responses.question: How will API credits be used?
responses.answer: Cadenza is early-stage and incomplete. API credits would support maintainer-reviewed work on minimal MusicXML compatibility cases, repeat/volta regressions, accessibility, documentation, issue triage, and bounded malformed-input tests. They would not fund a song catalogue or autonomous merges. The maintainer reviews all AI-assisted changes.

responses.question: Why does the project need Codex Security?
responses.answer: Cadenza is early-stage and incomplete. It processes untrusted MusicXML/MXL and MIDI, stores local user data, bridges .NET to WebView2, and accepts optional WinMM input. Codex Security could help model these boundaries and propose regression-backed fixes without implying a production security audit. The maintainer reviews all AI-assisted changes.

responses.question: Anything else we should know?
responses.answer: Cadenza is early-stage and incomplete, Windows-first, pre-release, and not significantly adopted. Clean-clone validation passes without MIDI or audio hardware; real devices, WebView2 UI, audio, accessibility, and release packaging still need manual work. No production-readiness or educational-effectiveness claim is made. The maintainer reviews all AI-assisted changes.
